title: Icizigiro cashizwe ku ruzi .
intro: Umushaha wari uhanganye n’itegeko ridashoboka, aho ubuzima bw’umwana aherutse kuvuka bwari bumanitse ku rugero. Iyobowe n’impwemu y’Imana, itegeko ry’ukwihebura ryarakurikijwe, kandi ibanga ry’agaciro ryarashizwe ku mazi, gusa riragaruka mu buryo butari bwitezwe.
clues: Nabaye mu gitutu c’umunyagitugu yategeka ko abana b’igitsina-gabo bakiri bato bica.
Ivyiyumviro vy’Imana vyaje kuri jewe, binyigisha gukora ikintu giteye ubwoba kandi kibabaza umutima.
Nashize uruyoya rwanje rw’agaciro mu gasandugu, ndarushira hejuru y’uruzi rwariko ruratemba.
Umutima wanje waracitse ubusa, nca nshaka guhishura ibanga, ariko Allah yarakomeje umwiyemezo wanje.
Narungitse umuntu ngo akurikire urugendo rw’uwo mwana aja mu ruzi uko umuyaga wariko uratwara igifu.
Uwo mwana yaronswe n’urugo rw’uwo munyagitugu, amaherezo, nanje ndasubirana n’umwana wanje, nca mba umuvyeyi w’umuvyeyi.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Nyina wa Muhanuzi Yahya (umugore wa Zakariya)

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yarashize umwana wiwe mu gasandugu, araheza amushira ku ruzi .
Yasize umwana wiwe ku muryango w'umusigiti .
trial.answer: Yarashize umwana wiwe mu gasandugu, araheza amushira ku ruzi .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yarasubiye kubonana n'umwana wiwe araheza aramuyonsa .
Yarimukiye mu kindi gihugu maze aba mu bunyagano .
outcome.answer: Yarasubiye kubonana n'umwana wiwe araheza aramuyonsa .

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
